steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—no prior work experience needed. This accessibility makes the credential ideal for South Bend professionals in healthcare, manufacturing, and technology roles seeking entry into formal project management. Verify your education meets PMI standards before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp, delivered synchronously to fit working professionals' schedules. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application in concentrated sessions. All instruction is online; no local classroom required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated examination fee. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the process to ensure accuracy and timely submission, so your credentials reach PMI without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence before test day. The proctored exam measures your mastery of project management processes and terminology. Schedule your exam date once you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Your CAPM is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units through training, volunteering, and contributions to the project management field. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure continuous credential renewal without gaps.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
